In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''truncated 16-cell honeycomb''' (or '''cantic tesseractic honeycomb''') is a uniform space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) in Euclidean 4-space. It is constructed by [[24-cell]] and [[truncated 16-cell]] [[Facet (geometry)|facets]].

== Alternate names==
* Truncated hexadecachoric tetracomb / Truncated hexadecachoric honeycomb
